>

Returns a user's profile. Use `me` as the user parameter to retrieve the authenticated user's own profile.

Requesting another user's profile requires the `User.Read.All` scope. The optional `?include=groups` query parameter requires the `Groups.Read` scope; without it the `groups` key is simply omitted (no error).
